name: Jackson County, AL
findings: Jackson County has 89 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jackson County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jackson County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
